steps.description: 4x5 grid. heights[c] will count consecutive 1s ending at the current row - each row is then a histogram problem.
row 0, col 0: grid=1 so heights[0]=1 (grew).
row 0, col 1: grid=0 so heights[1]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 0, col 2: grid=1 so heights[2]=1 (grew).
row 0, col 3: grid=0 so heights[3]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 0, col 4: grid=0 so heights[4]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 0: push col 0 (h=1); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [0].
row 0: bar 0 at col 1 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 0 (h=1), width 1−(-1)−1=1, area=1 - new best.
row 0: push col 1 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1].
row 0: push col 2 (h=1); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 2].
row 0: bar 0 at col 3 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 2 (h=1), width 3−(1)−1=1, area=1.
row 0: bar 0 at col 3 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 1 (h=0), width 3−(-1)−1=3, area=0.
row 0: push col 3 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [3].
row 0: bar 0 at col 4 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 3 (h=0), width 4−(-1)−1=4, area=0.
row 0: push col 4 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [4].
row 0: bar 0 at col 5 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 4 (h=0), width 5−(-1)−1=5, area=0 - sentinel flushes what remains.
row 1, col 0: grid=1 so heights[0]=2 (grew).
row 1, col 1: grid=0 so heights[1]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 1, col 2: grid=1 so heights[2]=2 (grew).
row 1, col 3: grid=1 so heights[3]=1 (grew).
row 1, col 4: grid=1 so heights[4]=1 (grew).
row 1: push col 0 (h=2); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [0].
row 1: bar 0 at col 1 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 0 (h=2), width 1−(-1)−1=1, area=2 - new best.
row 1: push col 1 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1].
row 1: push col 2 (h=2); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 2].
row 1: bar 1 at col 3 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 2 (h=2), width 3−(1)−1=1, area=2.
row 1: push col 3 (h=1); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 3].
row 1: bar 1 at col 4 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 3 (h=1), width 4−(1)−1=2, area=2.
row 1: push col 4 (h=1); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 4].
row 1: bar 0 at col 5 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 4 (h=1), width 5−(1)−1=3, area=3 - new best - sentinel flushes what remains.
row 1: bar 0 at col 5 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 1 (h=0), width 5−(-1)−1=5, area=0 - sentinel flushes what remains.
row 2, col 0: grid=1 so heights[0]=3 (grew).
row 2, col 1: grid=1 so heights[1]=1 (grew).
row 2, col 2: grid=1 so heights[2]=3 (grew).
row 2, col 3: grid=1 so heights[3]=2 (grew).
row 2, col 4: grid=1 so heights[4]=2 (grew).
row 2: push col 0 (h=3); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [0].
row 2: bar 1 at col 1 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 0 (h=3), width 1−(-1)−1=1, area=3.
row 2: push col 1 (h=1); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1].
row 2: push col 2 (h=3); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 2].
row 2: bar 2 at col 3 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 2 (h=3), width 3−(1)−1=1, area=3.
row 2: push col 3 (h=2); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 3].
row 2: bar 2 at col 4 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 3 (h=2), width 4−(1)−1=2, area=4 - new best.
row 2: push col 4 (h=2); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1, 4].
row 2: bar 0 at col 5 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 4 (h=2), width 5−(1)−1=3, area=6 - new best - sentinel flushes what remains.
row 2: bar 0 at col 5 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 1 (h=1), width 5−(-1)−1=5, area=5 - sentinel flushes what remains.
row 3, col 0: grid=1 so heights[0]=4 (grew).
row 3, col 1: grid=0 so heights[1]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 3, col 2: grid=0 so heights[2]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 3, col 3: grid=1 so heights[3]=3 (grew).
row 3, col 4: grid=0 so heights[4]=0 (zeroed - any rectangle using this column breaks here).
row 3: push col 0 (h=4); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [0].
row 3: bar 0 at col 1 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 0 (h=4), width 1−(-1)−1=1, area=4.
row 3: push col 1 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [1].
row 3: bar 0 at col 2 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 1 (h=0), width 2−(-1)−1=2, area=0.
row 3: push col 2 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [2].
row 3: push col 3 (h=3); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [2, 3].
row 3: bar 0 at col 4 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 3 (h=3), width 4−(2)−1=1, area=3.
row 3: bar 0 at col 4 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 2 (h=0), width 4−(-1)−1=4, area=0.
row 3: push col 4 (h=0); stack stays increasing bottom→top: [4].
row 3: bar 0 at col 5 ends taller-or-equal bars. Pop col 4 (h=0), width 5−(-1)−1=5, area=0 - sentinel flushes what remains.
Largest all-1s rectangle in the grid has area 6.
